note: Inyo NF campground at 8,600 ft in pinyon-juniper hills on paved White Mountain Rd, 5 miles below Schulman Grove in the Ancient Bristlecone Pine Forest; a dark-sky stargazing spot. Highway 168 up from Big Pine is narrow and steep with a single-lane section. No water anywhere nearby. --Claude
summary: Grandview (Inyo NF): FS page + rec.gov search + imagery. Keep. No rec.gov listing -> reservable false, fcfs always (FS: 'No reservations'). Free with $10 donation, 23 sites, vault toilets, no water, open year round. Website -> the campground's own FS page; phone -> WMPLIC.
flags: REC.GOV: no listing for this campground (the only 'Grandview Campground' on rec.gov is Colorado's 241113) - first-come confirmed by the FS page.

ACCESS (not a drop as worded): FS 'Highway 168 is narrow and steep. RV's and large vehicles should note a section of the road is a single lane with very limited visibility.' A caution, not a 'not recommended'.

PHONE: stored 760-873-2400 (Inyo NF supervisor's office) -> (760) 873-2501 (White Mountain Public Lands Information Center, the contact on the campground page; open Fri-Sat only) - reviewer's choice; 873-2400 is a valid forest line.
FIT: no rig length stated; 'Most sites are flat and sandy', parking for one or two vehicles; imagery shows open spurs. Inclusion stands.
PIN: stored 37.33350,-118.18730 is the entrance junction (~220 m from FS's point in the central flat) - fine.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed ('No natural water sources in this area').
